title: microsoft/TRELLIS.2: Generate detailed 3D assets from images
friendlyTitle: TRELLIS.2 turns pictures into detailed 3D objects
summary: TRELLIS.2 is Microsoft’s open 3D-generation system for producing detailed assets from image inputs using compact structured latent representations. The repository includes inference and training code, data tooling and an MIT licence, and had about 9,600 GitHub stars when reviewed.
friendlySummary: Microsoft’s open project can create 3D assets from images. It includes code for using and training the model and had about 9,600 stars on GitHub.
whyItMatters: 3D researchers and technical artists can experiment with image-to-asset pipelines, inspect the training stack or adapt the code for prototyping. The CUDA-heavy setup is best suited to users with capable Nvidia hardware and comfort running research software.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Researchers and 3D creators can study or test the system for prototypes. It needs strong Nvidia hardware and some technical setup.
